'''2019 MPC Shawn Dickson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Shawn Dickson]] at [[2019 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Shawn Dickson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Dickson LS 2019 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162035/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2019-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
